say:2:1523313001:0.text: Great! You two are finally back!
say:2:1523313001:0.source_cn: 太好了，你们终于回来了！

say:3:1523313002:1.text: How did it go? Did you find the seeds?
say:3:1523313002:1.source_cn: 怎么样？派翁先生留下的作物种子找到了吗？

say:4:1523313003:1.text: We found them, thanks to your trust, Regulus.
say:4:1523313003:1.source_cn: 仰仗殿下的信赖，我们的确找到了种子。

say:5:1523313004:1.text: But the modification was only half complete when disaster struck Tuttleton. It remains to be seen whether these seeds can truly grow.
say:5:1523313004:1.source_cn: 不过派翁的改良只完成了一半，图塔镇就遭遇了灾难。因此这...

say:7:1523313006:1.text: Let's give it a try then. I'll set aside a field outside the city for the experiments.
say:7:1523313006:1.source_cn: 那就试一试吧，我会派人到城外开垦一块农田来试验的。

say:9:1523313008:1.text: It'll be a while before we see results. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why don't you check back again after some time?
say:9:1523313008:1.source_cn: 从播种到抽穗需要一段时间。<style=stress>...
say:9:1523313008:1.male: It'll be a while before we see results. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why don't you check back again after some time?
say:9:1523313008:1.female: It'll be a while before we see results. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why don't you check back again after some time?

say:10:1523313009:1.text: Hopefully, these seeds will get Halia out of this bind...
say:10:1523313009:1.source_cn: 但愿这些苦苞穗种子能为呼临城带来好消息……
